title: Misleading Subscription Requirements and Poor Customer Support
text:
I spent considerable time recording and editing a video using Captions’ teleprompter, only to discover afterward that exporting my completed project required a paid subscription. This requirement was not clearly disclosed before I invested my time creating and editing the content.

To make matters worse, customer support provided conflicting information about subscription options and pricing. I was initially told the Basic plan cost $9.99/month, only to later be informed that the only available monthly option for my project was $19.99. Support acknowledged the inconsistent guidance but failed to offer a meaningful resolution.

I’m now left with a completed project that I cannot export without paying an unexpected subscription fee all for just one video.

My issue isn’t that the company charges for premium features. It’s the lack of transparency before users invest their time creating content, compounded by contradictory information from customer support.

I hope Captions takes responsibility, improves its disclosures, and offers a fair resolution to customers affected by these practices.

title: Questionable Subscription Practices - Beware
text:
This subscription practice is extremely disappointing. In my experience, if you cancel your subscription, they take away the unused credits you already paid for instead of allowing you to use them through the end of your paid billing period.

Most subscription services allow you to cancel renewal while keeping access to what you paid for until the subscription period expires. At the very least, I would expect purchased credits to remain available until the end of that billing cycle. Here, it appears you have to keep the subscription active just to avoid losing your remaining credits.

That creates an unnecessary incentive to delay cancellation, which also makes it easier to forget and get charged again the following month.

If I paid for the month and received credits as part of that purchase, those credits should not simply disappear because I decided not to renew.

So here is the feedback this policy earned. I hope other customers are aware of how cancellation affects their unused credits before subscribing.

Update: after back and forth they refunded me 3 months. I had all the proof with screenshots that I was ok the free version 


 I had canceled my subscription on the app and my app showed me that I was on the Free level with no paid subscription. Upon checking my accounts I found out that they have been charging me for 4 months while my app showed no active subscriptions. I have photos of my account showing I had no active subscription. And that I was on their FREE plan. The minute I raised the question through their chat and email - within 2 hours my app started showing I am on MAX level. I have time stamped photos to prove them wrong.
